description: This file defines the DynamoDBClusteringProviderBuilder class, which implements provider builder interfaces for configuring DynamoDB clustering options in Orleans silo and client builders. It registers providers via assembly attributes and contains methods to apply configuration settings from IConfigurationSection to DynamoDB clustering options.

classes.name: DynamoDBClusteringProviderBuilder
classes.description: Implements provider builder interfaces for configuring DynamoDB clustering in Orleans silos and clients.

methods.name: Configure (ISiloBuilder)
methods.description: Configures an ISiloBuilder with DynamoDB clustering options based on provided configuration section.

methods.name: Configure (IClientBuilder)
methods.description: Configures an IClientBuilder with DynamoDB clustering options based on provided configuration section.
